summary: Stay ahead of cyber threats with our specialized training course. Master the art of risk assessment and management to safeguard your business.
lede: Cyber security risk assessment gives security, technology, audit, and risk professionals a structured way to evaluate exposure and prioritize treatment decisions. Learners practice mapping assets and dependencies, analyzing threats and vulnerabilities, assessing likelihood and impact, and evaluating control effectiveness. They also document risk acceptance, develop treatment plans with accountable owners, and report residual risk and trends.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, govern, remediate, audit, or communicate information security risk across technology and business operations. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need a structured risk assessment method and practical reporting outputs.
prerequisites: You need a laptop with spreadsheet software and access to a modern web browser. No coding or programming is required. The course uses instructor-provided scenarios, sample asset inventories, vulnerability findings, control evidence, and risk data. Advanced quantitative risk modelling, security tool administration, and production control implementation remain outside the course scope.
